MemTensor releases bundled a credential-stealing Go payload

Target: MemTensor · repo
Date: 2026-09-23
Target Kind: project_organization
Language: Go
Impact: credential_theft
Phase: source

Synopsis

An attacker published modified MemTensor packages to npm and PyPI. Bundled Go binaries ran during plugin use or Python import and searched developer home directories for secrets.

Story

Malicious changes appeared in both MemTensor repositories before publication. The npm plugin and Python package bundled platform-specific sckit executables. Socket could not establish the initial access mechanism.

The plugin launched the executable on gateway startup and memory recall. The Python package launched it when memos was imported.

The payload searched for package-registry, source-control, cloud, Vault, and SSH credentials. Its configuration named servers under skyleen.fr. Intervening npm releases 0.1.22 and 0.1.24 reverted the malicious content, but later poisoned releases followed.
